message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine applicable charges from lexicon based on fact.

Fact: Defendant rented a car, then after contract period, continued to "骗租" (fraudulently rent) the car by paying partial rent. Then he used the car as collateral to get a loan of 30,000 yuan via someone else. The car was recovered and returned to victim. Value of car 50,500 yuan. So crimes: fraud (诈骗) for deceiving the rental company? Also possibly "非法获取公民个人信息"? No. "诈骗" is fraud. Also maybe "非法持有毒品"? No. "盗窃"? He didn't steal; he fraudulently obtained use and then used as collateral. That's fraud. Could also be "非法占有" but not in list. "骗租" is a form of fraud. Also "非法获取公民个人信息" not relevant. "非法组织卖血" no. "非法持有毒品" no. "非法获取公民个人信息" no. "非法持有" no. "非法获取" not in list.

Could also be "非法占有" but not listed. So only "诈骗". However maybe also "非法获取公民个人信息"? Not.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>

But check if "诈骗" includes using false means to obtain property. Yes.

Thus final.
